actions_or_findings.title: RELEASE_BLOCKER: Production media scan finalization remains open
actions_or_findings.trigger: Production storage registers a file with scanner_status=pending.
actions_or_findings.rationale: Attachment and download require clean or skipped_dev, and this remediation adds no production scan/finalize path. Production storage and private delivery still require release validation. This does not block acceptance of the Development slice.

unverified: I did not rerun the reported 42 targeted or 375 full unit passes. I inspected the assertions. The 29 integration tests remain collect-only because their fixture deletes protected shared database rows.

The native picker’s PNG/WebP branches were checked in code but were not exercised in the supplied page run. Related-work-order download authorization was checked in code; its unit test mocks the final authorization call.
I did not query the live database, process, queue, or worker. Production storage, scanner finalization, and private delivery were not validated.
session_note: Read-only remediation review at the stated HEAD; the reviewed source files have no working-tree diff. The three original current-task blockers are closed in code and failure-path assertions: attachment checks tenant, property, and uploader before storage access; committed missing objects return 503 without a write under a file row lock; persistent reads use disk first and evict stale cache. The image picker now maps JPEG, PNG, and WebP and shows an error for unknown formats. Both current screenshots were inspected: order 6 displays its image attachment, and tapping preview opens the native 1/1 view; the named API log records the download as 200. The overall goal remains frozen Production V1. Earlier accepted AUTO dispatch and order 5 lifecycle evidence remain intact. Existing dirty and untracked files were untouched.
task_result: PASS for PERSISTENT-MEDIA-001 remediation round 1. The supplied official-session evidence reads the original file after the API restart with its original hash; a same-byte retry returns 200 and different bytes return 409 FILE.CONFLICT. No current-task blocker remains.
product_gap_changes: Closed for this Development slice: cross-uploader attachment, committed-object replacement after storage loss, persistent-cache masking, and incorrect PNG/WebP picker declarations.
Production object storage, scan finalization, and private delivery remain release gaps.
Phone change, WeChat rebind, controlled merge, recovery, real AI auto-assignment, real Embedding/RAG, and the other handoff Production V1 gaps remain in scope.
schedule_risk: High. The original one-week aim is approximately through 2026-09-21. On 2026-09-20, the remaining frozen V1 features and production validation cannot be completed by that date without dropping scope.
next_action: Main Codex should implement one production-media scan/finalize code slice: verify stored bytes and MIME, transition pending files to clean or blocked under the file row lock, retain pending/blocked attachment and download denial, and cover clean, malicious, missing-object, timeout, retry, and concurrency paths with unit tests. Completion requires passing focused tests and an independent read-only review. Ordinary source and unit work is authorized; any migration, shared-service operation, credentials, paid resource, or production deployment needs separate approval.
